purpose: Controlled setup plan for Etsy, WhatsApp Business API, Jumia, and Amazon channels

pilot.rule: No channel publication until channel authorization, product evidence, and reversible verification are complete.

required: Active Etsy shop in good standing
OAuth 2.0 authorization with listings read/write scopes as required
Product image, title, description, price, quantity, shipping/readiness data
etsy.publication: Draft-first; activate only after evidence gate and Etsy validation

whatsapp_business_api.integration: Meta WhatsApp Business Platform / Cloud API
required: Business access token stored only in secret storage
Webhook verification token + app secret stored only in secret storage
Message templates approved before business-initiated messaging
whatsapp_business_api.publication: No bulk outbound messaging; policy-compliant opt-in and template workflow required

required: API credentials or approved integration credentials
Product identity, price, stock, images, and category mapping
jumia.publication: Pilot only; no bulk marketplace publication while Commercial Publish Gate is CLOSED

amazon.integration: Amazon Seller Central + Selling Partner API (SP-API)
required: Professional selling account for a private SP-API app
LWA client credentials and refresh token in secret storage
amazon.publication: Pilot only; Amazon authorization and product eligibility must be verified first

executionOrder: WhatsApp Business Platform credentials + webhook verification
